summary: Rebuilt binary from current toolchain closes the silent mkdir failure; dist/ is now ignored so the 100MB artifact cannot be committed by accident.
findings: Stale dist/subaru (older Deno runtime) issued no mkdir syscall, so sqlode init could not create directories; rebuilt binary issues mkdir(.../db)=0 and completes init/generate/verify.
evidence_refs: strace -f -e trace=mkdir dist/subaru --git https://github.com/nao1215/sqlode --ref main -- init
